coverage.evidence: dashboard/src/views/dashboard/economy/EconomyView.vue:88-98 puts the Leaderboards tab behind economy:leaderboards:config:read and New leaderboard behind config:write. ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:467-469 seeds read, write and delete at Mod (10), and :51-54 puts Lead moderator, Editor and Broadcaster higher. useTabbedPage.ts:67 hides the tab without read. LeaderboardDialog.vue:44-48 sets the defaults to Balance, Whole channel, All time, 10 and on, and :32-34 sets the choices. i18n/en.json:171-211 holds the labels, the empty text, the detail line, Private, the Pick a jar text and Save leaderboard.

server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Economy/EconomyLeaderboardService.cs:304 gives Balance no period window. :333-339 makes Earned the sum of positive ledger amounts since the start of the window and Spent the sum of negative ones. :315-316 and :460-461 make All time read LifetimeEarned and LifetimeSpent. :297-298 and :400-407 rank a jar by Contribute movements whatever the metric. :384-398 requires that the channel owns the jar or has an accepted membership. :450-452 puts Daily at today's UTC date, Weekly at the latest Sunday and Monthly at the 1st, all UTC. :292-295 and :311 leave opted-out viewers out.

server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Commands/Builtins/LeaderboardBuiltin.cs:37 and :72 make TopN 5 whatever the board's TopN. :50 picks the first public config and otherwise configs[0]. EconomyLeaderboardService.cs:53 orders the list by Metric, which is the alphabetical order balance, earned, spent. :121 shows that delete only sets DeletedAt on the config, and en.json:182 is the text 'The ranking stops. Balances stay.'. LeaderboardBuiltin.cs:34-35 sets a 90-second cooldown and level 0 (everyone), and :62 and :85 are the fallback texts, the same as the default Informative tone (ToneTemplateCatalog.Core.cs:291 and :303, Channel.cs:88).

reader_answers.evidence: The tab, the New leaderboard dialog, the fields and Save leaderboard match EconomyView.vue:88-98, LeaderboardDialog.vue:100-194 and en.json:200-210. The dialog closes on success at LeaderboardDialog.vue:95. The command takes the top 5 of the first public board (LeaderboardBuiltin.cs:37 and :50).

The four roles come from ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:51-54 and :467-469. The tab is hidden without read (useTabbedPage.ts:67). Chat shows one board, chosen by list order (LeaderboardBuiltin.cs:50, EconomyLeaderboardService.cs:53). The jar access need is at EconomyLeaderboardService.cs:384-398.

The row detail '{scope} · {period} · top {top}' and the Private badge are at en.json:177-178 and LeaderboardsPanel.vue:92-106. The reply carries the rank, the Twitch ID as DisplayName and the value (LeaderboardBuiltin.cs:94, EconomyLeaderboardService.cs:156). Balance is a point in time and earned or spent uses the window (EconomyLeaderboardService.cs:304-306).

An Earned, Weekly, Whole channel board sums positive ledger entries since the latest Sunday at midnight UTC (EconomyLeaderboardService.cs:333-339 and :451). Ordering by Metric puts balance first (:53), and the builtin takes the first public board (LeaderboardBuiltin.cs:50), so every visible Balance board has to be made private.
